title: Japan 20-Year JGB auction (issue 198 first reopening expected, ¥700bn anticipated) — the same-day pairing with the US 20-year, and the auction that cannot rescue the bucket-taper test it was proposed to power
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 for this initial research (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes — byte-identical to the jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 lane's fetch of the same day, so nothing on the page has moved); its table row reads 'Nov. 18, 2026 | 20-year'. The DATE is MOF's own. The SIZE is anticipated, not announced: NO November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-11-11. ¥700bn is the base case from MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, downloaded and parsed 2026-09-09 — 343 twenty-year auctions), where the 20-year has run monthly at ¥700bn since 2026-04-14, corroborated by two MOF pages the workbook does not carry: result page calendar/eresul/eresul20260820.htm (¥532.1bn competitive + ¥167.4bn non-price-competitive I = ¥699.5bn against a ¥700bn offering) and announcement calendar/announcement/auct20260908e.htm, which names 'About 700 billion yen' for 2026-09-15. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, promoting the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18.from-jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20.json, read in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md and now shadowed). Ledger: docs/research/events/jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18.md. THE PROPOSAL'S OWN STATED RATIONALE IS REFUTED ON ARITHMETIC. It earned its slot as 'the second observation this DiD's power needs' after the 10-20 ledger measured the BoJ bucket-taper effect on 20-year auction demand at DiD -0.412bp, t = -0.77, against a test that only detects ~1.5bp. Adding one month-matched pair moves the minimum detectable effect from 1.50bp to 1.47bp — a 2% improvement. Reaching 1.2bp needs 35 pairs in the post-taper window (about 1.5 more years of monthly auctions), 1.0bp needs 78 (about 5 more years), and there is a HARD FLOOR at 0.81bp set by the 15 period-A observations, which are historical and can never grow. No realistic number of future auctions rehabilitates that test. WHAT THE EVENT IS ACTUALLY WORTH, measured this session. (1) It validates the sibling's DiD design on an axis nobody had checked: MOF has run the 20-year and 30-year issue cycles in exact lockstep since 2013-06-18 — 158 consecutive month-matched pairs, 100% position-matched (new against new, first reopening against first reopening), last mismatch 2013-05-28 — so the month-matched gap can never mix a new issue against a reopening, and both DiD windows sit wholly inside the lockstep. November continues it: the 20-year on 11-18 is issue 198's first reopening and the 30-year on 11-10 is issue 92's. (2) The clock reverses the 10-20 ledger's sequencing ranking. Tokyo's entire cash session on any date D closes 15:00 JST = 01:00 ET the SAME calendar date (JST = EST+14 in November), so a same-calendar-date JGB result is already complete before the US session opens — same-day is the TIGHTER pairing, not the contaminated one. The JGB result precedes the US 1:00pm ET stop by roughly 14 hours on 2026-11-18 against roughly 38 on the 10-20/10-21 pair. The offsetting cost is specific: treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 is same-day and is itself a NEW issue bidding one hour before fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 at 2:00pm ET with tic-monthly-2026-11-18 at 4:00pm, so the US close-to-close CMT is a joint observation and only the auction-to-auction leg is clean. (3) Do not carry 10-20's result into this print. The 20-year's cover autocorrelation is +0.627 (t = +14.9) on the full 343-auction history and +0.581 (t = +8.4) from 2015, and it is GONE from 2023: +0.025, t = +0.16, Fisher-z +3.55 against the modern sample. The tail's strong version dies too (+0.407 -> -0.059, z = +2.94 against the full history) though a weak 2015-era value cannot be excluded (z = +1.28). NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` on the same evidence the 10-20 ledger measured at this exact tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and the JGB-auction-to-US-long-end association does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
